services.name: Wine Tasting Events
services.desc: We’ll have delicious bites to complement the wines. This will be a formal sit-down tasting for up to 10 guests. Reservations must be paid in advance. Start time 6pm. This will be a great opportunity to evaluate six different vineyard locations of Turley Zinandels. 1-Turley Wine Cellars 2021 Evangelho Vineyard Contra Costa County Zinfandel California Antonio Galloni 93-95 Rating $44.99 The 2021 Zinfandel Evangelho emerges from the front block of the vineyard, where the Zinfandel-based field blend includes Carignan, Mataro and Palomino. Dark and enveloping, the 2021 offers tremendous intensity and tons of character. Readers will find a wine of uncommon depth, complexity and pedigree. 2-Turley
